title: F169.1 flat's lines and inks: the overview
caption: Four picks become two values in flat's sheets, three rules of the framework and three new names for a code word, each held by a test.

cards.title: F169.1 Flat's lines and inks
cards.text: Every word, line and ring on a flat page can be read: words at 4.5 to 1 or more, the ring at 3 to 1.

cards.title: Flat's values
cards.text: Dark's line goes to #404048. The faint grey goes to #5f5f6c in the light and #8c8c98 in the dark. Steps 2 and 3.

cards.title: Three rules of the framework
cards.text: The keyboard's ring is whole, the topic line reads the theme's purple, a quiet control takes the hairline. Steps 4, 5 and 6.

cards.title: A code word's three names
cards.text: Every theme sets them. The page and Orbi's answers read them. Steps 7 and 8.

cards.title: The tests that hold them
cards.text: A new test holds flat's inks to its grounds, and the contrast sum gets a type of its own. Step 3.
